title: New Monthly Payment Arrangements on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Accounts
content:
**Arrangement agreement terms and tool card — new monthly arrangements on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility accounts.**

## Terms

A new monthly payment arrangement is set on a coverage account with no arrangement active, whose patient balance is at least the class's smallest balance for an arrangement, once a payment-plan agreement request for the account is approved; the installments fall due from the start date the patient chooses, no later than one statement cycle after the agreement was approved.

The monthly installment of a new arrangement is fixed only after the arrangement deposit stands on the account as a patient-payment entry posted on the day the arrangement is set.

| Condition on record | Read from |
|---|---|
| No arrangement active on the account | the coverage record's payment-arrangement status |
| Patient balance at least the class's smallest balance for an arrangement | the coverage account's patient balance |
| Payment-plan agreement request approved | the request attached to the account |
| First due date no later than one statement cycle after the agreement's approval | the start date the patient chooses |

## Putting the arrangement in force: `set_payment_arrangement_62cec67a`

**Capability.** The tool puts a new monthly payment arrangement in force on a coverage account, as the patient's own act. One call marks the account's payment arrangement as active and records the agreed monthly installment and the date the installments begin falling due; the account's arrangement fields then carry that installment and due date.

**Invocation.** The customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `set_payment_arrangement_62cec67a` with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `coverage_id` — the reference number of the coverage account (the insurance coverage record on the patient's file) the arrangement is set on, as given to the patient by the agent from the coverage lookup. Identifier.
- `monthly_amount` — the agreed monthly installment, in USD: a positive figure with 2 decimal places (cents), stored exactly as given, rounded half up to the cent.
- `start_date` — the calendar date the installments begin falling due, written YYYY-MM-DD (local calendar date, no time part); installments then fall due on the same day of each later month.

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with `coverage_id` (the account the arrangement is set on), `payment_plan_status` (the string "active"), `monthly_amount` (the installment recorded, USD with 2 decimals), `start_date` (the opening due date recorded, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, the string "arrangement_active". A receipt whose status is "arrangement_active" means the arrangement is in force.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Run with account C-4, a monthly amount of 51.72 and a start date of 2026-11-10, the tool returns payment-arrangement status "active", monthly amount 51.72 and start date 2026-11-10; installments then fall due on the 10th of each later month.
